about: The hosts the box runners' way out lets a runner reach (#5495): the proxy thornswood-agent egress, on loopback at listen, which Install-RunnerEgress.ps1 runs as the task Thornswood Runner Egress. These are the hosts GitHub documents for a self-hosted runner: github.com, api.github.com and *.actions.githubusercontent.com to take jobs (vstoken among them, the token host GitHub gave tw-hermes-box on 3 Nov 2026), codeload.github.com and pkg.actions.githubusercontent.com for actions, the objects, releases and registry hosts for the runner's own updates and actions/setup-python's Python, and the twenty productionresultssa storage accounts for logs, artifacts and caches, each by name so no other Azure storage account is reachable. raw.githubusercontent.com is where actions/setup-python reads its list of Python builds. A runner record that is sent through the proxy ("egress": true) adds its allowHost. Patrick chose on 3 Nov 2026 to decide by host name rather than address.
